name: Innocent Blood
source:
Disaster stroke a city few years ago... survivors of the incident gathered together to re-build another city.

People's lives seemed to gone back to normal, but one day, an incident happened.
Akitsu met a boy called Seki at this incident...and it changed everything.

Boy's love adventure for adults.

*Though this work is for 18+, it is not focused on.
Please note that this work contains violent and grotesque expressions.
